description: Retrieval regression set keyed on stable evidence ROLES (and form/period) rather than volatile chunk ids, so it survives re-ingestion. role recall = fraction of expected roles populated in the final evidence pack; role precision = share of surfaced roles that were expected. Run against a DB seeded with AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/JPM.

cases.question: Tell me what matters in Apple's latest 10-Q.
What are Apple's main risk factors?
Why did Microsoft's revenue grow year over year?
What was NVIDIA's revenue in the latest quarter?
What are Tesla's key risk factors?
